handoff_goal.objective: Review the kept same-host peer-mesh runtime slice and generate the next bounded implementation prompt.
handoff_goal.why_now: The prior run landed runtime proof and the next agent should consume exact evidence instead of reconstructing the slice from scratch.
handoff_goal.best_next_slice: Schema-hardening or next-lane activation driven by exact runtime truth.

options.title: Tighten the governed prompt contracts only.
options.rationale: This keeps the next slice on schema and template surfaces without widening into runtime implementation.

options.title: Refresh the parent-only prompt templates and examples.
options.rationale: This keeps the contract readable for the next worker without claiming new runtime behavior.

options.title: Prepare a governed extension request for later follow-up.
options.rationale: This records any needed extension without mutating validator or scorer surfaces in the same slice.

decision_space.blocker_or_escalation_path: Escalate to the orchestrator-validator if the next worker needs validator or scorer changes outside the owned prompt surfaces.

ordered_steps: Read the upstream report and owned prompt surfaces first.
Confirm the linked consumers and policy mode match the governed triad contract.
Choose one option from the declared decision space before drafting the next prompt.
Generate both the structured prompt artifact and the markdown companion artifact.
runtime_truth_expectations: Carry forward exact upstream runtime-truth claims without upgrading blocked lanes.
Keep runtime-truth requirements visible in the next structured prompt.
blocker_expectations: Escalate if the next slice would require unowned validator or scorer changes.
Do not soften blocked dependencies into optional prose.
freshness_expectations: Use the current repo truth instead of replaying stale prompt assumptions.
Treat unrefreshed evidence as non-authoritative for new claims.
command_evidence_expectations: Require the next structured prompt to preserve command-evidence requirements.
Require dispatch output to point back to the structured prompt and companion markdown artifact.

checks: Validate the architect handoff schema shape.
Confirm the decision-space block stays complete.
Confirm the follow-up prompt preserves runtime-truth and command-evidence requirements.
validation_loop.rerun_policy: Repeat the bounded review until the governed outputs are complete or the exact blocker is proven.

message_requirements: Reference the handoff id and the recommended decision option.
Point at both the structured prompt artifact and the markdown companion artifact.
